missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Заявление' is a neuter noun in the nominative. 'Важное' is the agreeing neuter adjective and 'было' is the neuter past tense. A basic descriptive model.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Заявление' is the accusative direct object of 'написал'; neuter accusative matches the nominative. 'Об отпуске' specifies the topic. A common bureaucratic phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Заявлении' is prepositional after 'в', the document within which something is found. 'Серьёзная ошибка' is the nominative subject. A practical office phrase.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Заявления' is the genitive modifying 'текст', the text of what. 'Длинный' is the agreeing masculine adjective for 'текст'. Common in document review.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Заявлению' is dative after 'к', expressing what was added to. 'Подпись' is the accusative object. A formal paperwork pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Заявлением' is instrumental after 'с', the manner of speaking out. 'Громким' agrees in the neuter instrumental. Common in news language.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'Заявлении' is prepositional after 'об', the topic of the dispute. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional. Useful for reporting reactions.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Заявления' is the accusative plural object of 'принимает', the documents received; neuter plural accusative equals the nominative. 'Все' is the agreeing quantifier.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Заявлений' is the genitive plural after 'десятки', expressing a large count. Note the zero-ending plural typical of neuter '-ие' nouns. A workload image.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Заявлениях' is the prepositional plural after 'в', the documents within which errors appear. 'Новых' agrees in the prepositional plural. A review observation.
